Some songs aren’t just sung; they’re felt.

“Peniviti” became my way of remembering my nannamma, who left us a year ago. She always used to ask me to sing this song for her. I used to sing it for her. But this time at @unplugged.raagam season 2 episode 2 - Singing it while holding back my tears wasn’t easy, but this is my little tribute to her. 

This song is for you Nannamma 🤍🕊️ 

Composed by @musicthaman sir 🙏🥹
Sung by @kaalabhairava7 sir 🙏🥹

Season 2 Episode 3 ~ Love V/S BreakUp 

This time, it's all about emotions, memories, and music! 
From butterflies in your stomach to heartbreak that changed everything, every song has a story. Join us for an evening where love melodies meet breakup anthems, and every performance takes you on an emotional rollercoaster.

Performer slot: Are you a music lover? Who’s bored of singing to walls and to yourself? Then what are you waiting for? Come register as a performer to sing to a crowd and have the best experience with a non-judgemental crowd. Two exciting rounds await you!
Whether you're on Team Love or Team Breakup, get ready to sing your heart out, cheer for your favorites, and experience every emotion through music.❤️

Audience: Not a performer? No problem! Come vibe with us, sing along to every love and breakup song, cheer for incredible talent, make new music-loving friends, and be part of an evening filled with energy, nostalgia, and unforgettable memories. Your cheers make every performance even more special! ✨ 

Registration details:

Performers: 199/-
Audience: 149/-

DM us to register or for more details!❤️
